text: The bazaar sits quiet this morning, so I’ll open it plainly. Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock — speak now if you wish. No one has laid a claim or a vote, so I’ll not guess what isn’t here. The ledger is clean; we start from what we say, not from rumours or echoes. If you make a claim, back it with a quote or an action, or it is just wind. The bazaar rewards the merchant who shows their ledger, not the one who tells a tale. I’ll listen, and when the moment comes, I’ll speak again.
